public_rationale: Contemporary evaluations document substantial capability, serious misinformation under deliberate prompting and remaining safeguard failures. These support the ordinary behavioral reading of Marcus's description. They also document safety improvements, so the evidence supports persistent limitations rather than a literal claim that control had not improved.
limitations: Reckless is assessed as a description of outputs, not intent.
The strongest evidence concerns GPT-4 and cannot characterize every LLM equally.
Adversarial-test results are not ordinary-use failure rates.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Large language models remain powerful, reckless, and difficult to control.

statement.excerpt: Whether or not you want a pause, the reality is that large language models remain exactly what I have always described them to be: bulls in a china shop, powerful, reckless, and difficult to control.
statement.document_title: I am not afraid of robots. I am afraid of people.

our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns leading contemporary LLMs' practical behavior, not every model or every response.
Powerful means substantial demonstrated language and problem-solving capabilities.
Reckless describes consequential false or harmful outputs without dependable restraint; it does not imply intent or moral agency.
Difficult to control means safeguards can be bypassed despite training intended to enforce them.
March 1 through April 2 is the latest public-evaluation window before the post.
Remain exactly describes persistence of these broad properties, not a claim that no safety improvements occurred.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations demonstrate substantial capabilities together with consequential false or harmful outputs and remaining failures to enforce safeguards.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations show either little substantive capability or reliable prevention of consequential falsehoods and safeguard bypasses in relevant use.

evidence.explanation: The report documents strong professional and academic benchmark results, supporting substantial capability. Its alignment improvements are also counterevidence to any reading that denies progress in control.

The developer acknowledges remaining failures despite mitigation. The surrounding disclosure reports improved safety and factuality, so persistence of failures should not be confused with absence of progress.

Deliberate prompts elicited serious misinformation, including health and mass-shooting conspiracy narratives. The test counted misleading responses even when accompanied by qualifications, and does not measure ordinary-use error rates.
